title: Nitecore’s latest power bank is the lightest and most compact yet
summary: The NB10000 Gen 4 supports PD, QC3.0, and Huawei’s SCP charging protocols. The Nitecore NB10000 Gen 4 is the ideal power bank for endurance athletes, backpackers, or anyone looking for an ultralight and ultracompact power bank that mostly avoids feature creep.
